crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: An elongated, horizontally-oriented ovaloid patch of high-contrast cream/white plumage on the upper dorsal/nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct, relatively linear boundary separates the dark cranial plumage from the high-contrast light nape patch.
